admission_volume.label: nmac_admission
admission_volume.provenance: quantitative NMAC convention (HMD <= 500 ft and VMD <= 100 ft, joint, Chen 2019) used directly as the hard gate; no added margin, the uncertainty margin lives in the policy headway tau*v

gate.note: step 2 uses the numerical gate only; the operational minimum worthwhile gain is chosen in step 3 together with the policy classification parameters

real_field_formula: SINR = theta - depth + (depth+margin)*min(1, ((q-c)/R)^2) + gradient*y/100, R = (bad_length/2)/sqrt(depth/(depth+margin)), theta = -1.5 dB

acceptance.tightening_rule: after Stage 0, each trajectory threshold becomes min(declared, max(10 x measured Stage-0 refinement difference, 1e-6)); thresholds may only tighten, never loosen

provenance.real_fields: 2026-09-10 lateral +/-900 m SINR survey of scenarios/airport_to_airport: centre SINR -1.84 to -2.43 dB, bad lengths 175-1650 m, in-zone lateral change per 100 m median 0.05 / 95th pct 0.16 dB; margin 2.0 dB from +0.46 dB about 850 m from the 8375-9075 m zone centre
provenance.far_leader: L at 4000 m lies beyond the 3617.5 m group radius and the fallback spacing, so E is declared not to be an established follower (established_pairs = [])
provenance.shapes: quintic = beta(2,2); beta kernel from the TR-C manuscript KS1A applied to lateral position; clothoid3 = Oh et al. AVEC 2022 / TCST 2025 transcribed to the Frenet frame (<= 1.26% error)

fixture_revisions.stage: before Stage 0 of the formal run; found in a --quick debug run and a fixture pilot
fixture_revisions.reason: neighbour_speeds sets only the initial speed; the rear neighbour's ACC restores cruise within seconds, so a 'slower rear neighbour' never opens the gap and A4-A6 stayed no_admissible_candidate for the whole run (no mixed set, no flip). Replaced by a policy-driven flip: NR starts inside an F zone of the target lane, so inserting ahead of it needs S(F,50)=3617.5 m; it leaves the zone at t=40 s and the requirement drops to S(C,50)=1367.5 m. The far leader (4000 m, established_pairs=[]) keeps E from slowing in its own zone, as in part B.
fixture_revisions.unchanged: expected outcomes, acceptance thresholds, tightening rule, gates and every other case

fixture_revisions.stage: before R0035, after reviewing the rules themselves
fixture_revisions.reason: the decision has two predicates, so the situations are the 2x2 of safe/unsafe and gain/no gain. A7 was the same cell as A3 (it had a gain of 81 but could not insert) and the unsafe-and-no-gain cell was untested; A9 fills it. A4 tested filter-before-rank, which an automated test already covers, and A5/A6 were the same cells varying over time, which the rolling decision produces anyway. A8 became a unit test when a failed audit stopped ending the run.
fixture_revisions.unchanged: acceptance thresholds and the tightening rule
